inbound.choose:
<when condition="@{
        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
        return body != null
               && (string)body["method"] == "tools/call"
               && (string)body["params"]?["name"] == "getCustomerById";
      }">

        
        <set-variable name="mcpRequestId"
                      value="@{
                        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                        return body["id"]?.ToString() ?? "1";
                      }" />

        <set-variable name="customerId"
                      value="@{
                        var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                        return (string)body["params"]["arguments"]["customerId"];
                      }" />

        
        
          
            
              
              
                text/event-stream
              
              
                no-cache
              
              @{
                long n;
                var rawId = (string)context.Variables["mcpRequestId"];
                JToken reqId = long.TryParse(rawId, out n) ? (JToken)n : (JToken)rawId;
                var err = new JObject(
                  new JProperty("jsonrpc", "2.0"),
                  new JProperty("id", reqId),
                  new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                    new JProperty("code", -32602),
                    new JProperty("message", "Invalid params: customerId is required")
                  ))
                );
                return "data: " + err.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None) + "\n\n";
              }
            
          
        

        
        
          @(context.Api.ServiceUrl.ToString().TrimEnd('/') + "/api/customers/" + (string)context.Variables["customerId"])
          GET
          
            application/json
          
          
          
            @(context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key", ""))
          
        

        
        
          
          
            text/event-stream
          
          
            no-cache
          
          
            keep-alive
          
          @{
            var backendResp = ((IResponse)context.Variables["backendResponse"]);
            var statusCode  = backendResp.StatusCode;
            var bodyText    = backendResp.Body.As();

            // Parse mcpRequestId as JToken to preserve original type (number vs string)
            JToken requestId;
            try {
              var rawId = (string)context.Variables["mcpRequestId"];
              // Try to keep as number if it was a number
              long numId;
              requestId = long.TryParse(rawId, out numId) ? (JToken)numId : (JToken)rawId;
            } catch {
              requestId = 1;
            }

            // Build the MCP JSON-RPC response object
            var mcpResponse = new JObject(
              new JProperty("jsonrpc", "2.0"),
              new JProperty("id", requestId)
            );

            if (statusCode == 200)
            {
              mcpResponse["result"] = new JObject(
                new JProperty("content", new JArray(
                  new JObject(
                    new JProperty("type", "text"),
                    new JProperty("text", bodyText)
                  )
                )),
                new JProperty("isError", false)
              );
            }
            else if (statusCode == 404)
            {
              mcpResponse["result"] = new JObject(
                new JProperty("content", new JArray(
                  new JObject(
                    new JProperty("type", "text"),
                    new JProperty("text", "Customer '" + (string)context.Variables["customerId"] + "' not found.")
                  )
                )),
                new JProperty("isError", true)
              );
            }
            else
            {
              mcpResponse["error"] = new JObject(
                new JProperty("code", -32603),
                new JProperty("message", "Backend error " + statusCode + ": " + bodyText)
              );
            }

            // SSE format: "data: {json}\n\n"
            return "data: " + mcpResponse.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None) + "\n\n";
          }
